categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Changes .github/workflows/ci.yml and multiple ci/test/ scripts to replace FreeBSD cross-compilation with native VM testing.
categories.rationale: Enables per-PR native CI testing on FreeBSD to prevent platform regressions from reaching master. The description notes that recent BSD regressions were caught only reactively in external nightlies (#36078 and #36145), and reviewers agreed that running tests in Core CI is needed to reliably support the platform.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label, executes the functional test suite on a new platform, and updates test/functional/test_framework/netutil.py to run cleanly on FreeBSD.
categories.rationale: Extends test runner execution to native BSD environments while making minor framework adjustments to silence lsof warnings. The change primarily exercises existing tests rather than adding new test infrastructure or framework capabilities, but it ensures functional tests run reliably on BSD hosts.
